description: 한국가스공사_무상 기술나눔 대상 목록 조회 [gas networks] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국가스공사. 한국가스공사가 보유한 지식재산권 중 민간에 무상으로 나눔(양도, 통상실시권)하고 있는 목록. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국가스공사. Its tags are 기술이전, 지식재산권, 특허, 한국가스공사, 무상 기술. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2025-12-10 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support gas network and biomethane studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
